name: Yasuoka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yasuoka village emblem in white and black: a white ring enclosing a black disc with white stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Yasuoka, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Yasuoka village emblem — a white ring enclosing a black disc with white stylised characters
